content: Hello, thank you for contacting Amazon support. My name is Daniel. I see you recently had an issue with your order. Can I get your full name and the best phone number to reach you, please?
Yes, my name is Maria Santos. My phone is 555-239-0841.
Thank you, Maria. For security, could you also confirm the email address linked to your Amazon account?
It is mariasantos22@gmail.com.

Perfect, I have your details now. I'm looking at your order and I notice it's been delayed at customs due to a regulatory check. This is something we sometimes see, but don't worry, we'll help you get it sorted.
Why it is delayed? I did not know there is problem.

It's a routine process, Maria. Customs sometimes holds packages until a small government fee is paid for release. This is standard for international shipments and Amazon helps customers through it. We'll make sure you get your item or a full refund.
I need pay more money? I not understand.

It's just a temporary customs holding fee, which is $79.99. As soon as it's paid, your order will be released or, if you prefer, we can process your refund. Amazon will reimburse this fee within 2-3 business days.
So I pay now, then get money back, yes?
Exactly, Maria. This is a refundable deposit. Once customs clears your package, we'll credit the amount directly to your account. I will guide you step by step to complete this quickly.
Okay, but I not have credit card now. What I do?
No problem. The fastest way is with an Amazon Gift Card. You can buy one at any major store or online. I'll walk you through how to do this and where to enter the code.
I have store near. I go buy card?
Yes, please purchase an Amazon Gift Card for $80. Once you have it, just scratch off the back to reveal the code and let me know. I'll wait here and guide you with the next steps.
I go now. You wait?
Of course, Maria. Take your time. I'll stay on the line to make sure this is completed smoothly for you.
I have card now, $80.
Great! Please read the code from the back of the card to me. I'll verify and process the customs fee on your behalf immediately.
The code is 7J8D-9TRK-LP3Q-X7W4.
Thank you, Maria. I'm entering the code now. Can you also confirm your shipping address so we can ensure delivery once clearance is complete?
My address is 1210 Willow Lane, Apt 6, Bayview.
Perfect, that matches our system. Just to keep you updated, the code is being processed. This usually takes 15-30 minutes. Please do not share this code with anyone else for your security.
Okay, I wait. You call if problem?
Absolutely, Maria. If there are any additional steps, I will contact you directly. You should see a confirmation email soon as well. Is there anything else I can help with while we wait?
